capture.content_gates: OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES=1 for the content-present event; unset (default) for the redacted event
capture.note: assistant_response always carries response_length, model, and request_id. The response text is present verbatim under OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES=1 (event_sequence 12); by default the wire carries the literal string "<REDACTED>" (event_sequence 20), which is captured as received and never re-redacted or dropped (epic #87 / #94). Responses here are synthetic. See the -otlp fixture for the wire form and the dropped message.uuid correlation id.

observations.name: response_content
observations.evidence: assistant_response carries response (behind OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES) plus response_length, model, and request_id; it maps to a canonical.Event whose provider_extensions.event echoes response/response_length/model/query_source verbatim and namespaces request_id. The default event proves the provider-emitted "<REDACTED>" sentinel is captured as received, not synthesised.
